_comment: Upstream items this tree removed on purpose, each with the reason. tools/upstream_parity.py reports everything else as a gap. Remove an entry when the tool calls it no longer needed.

event.ad_gems_cap_reached: came from orchestrator.free_gems_due, which nothing upstream called
event.ad_gems_claimed: came from orchestrator.free_gems_mark_claimed, which nothing upstream called; the collector logs ad_gems_claim
event.calibrate_cards_progress: card scan progress goes through Calibration.progress('cards', ...) (player/calibrate.py)
event.combo_stop_timeout: the day plan no longer kills a runner after 8 h (hard rule 3); it logs combo_boundary_overdue and keeps waiting
event.flow_battle_incomplete: setup errors fail closed through _setup_lifecycle; 'did not return Home' raises (player/flow_capture.py)
event.flow_intro_sprint_error: capture_intro_sprint errors propagate to _setup_lifecycle instead of being logged and ignored
event.flow_uw_error: capture_uw_weapons errors propagate to _setup_lifecycle instead of being logged and ignored
event.module_assumed_equipped: loadout equips are verified after the tap instead of assumed from absence (interactions/loadout.py)

def.backend/scheduling/chores.py:_done_today: replaced by chores.decide on catalog schedules
def.backend/scheduling/daystate.py:_utc_toda: only served the dead free_gems_* counters
def.backend/scheduling/daystate.py:bump_utc_: only served the dead free_gems_* counters
def.backend/scheduling/daystate.py:get_utc_t: only served the dead free_gems_* counters
def.frontend/dashboard.py:_clear_stop_flag: inlined in the clear_flag control action (backend/dashboard.py)
def.frontend/dashboard.py:_connected: status reports connected from the adb transport state instead of a TCP dial
